text:
HDFCBank -- one of biggest privet sector bank in India. while Government owned banks are making donwtrend and also other private banks giving negative sentiments this bank and it's subling HDFC (financial sector) are continuously making all time highs.

Here is some thought process on it. price just manage to engulf the ORFL and created new FL. but then that FL was quickly engulfed with strong gap down. It's interesting that without any news or events such trendy stock is gapping down.

As Master Sali said, when price engulfs FL then it will move to opposite FL and in this case it's ORFL which left behind untraded. few exits will be LTF (5m & 1m DZ) lvl's which have fair enough importance.

Bharat Forge Limited -- is engaged in the business of steel forgings, finished machined crankshafts, and front axles assembly and components. The Company's segments include Forgings and Projects (Capital goods).

Price is at weekly high. No LTF flag exits inbetween. MPL is the only answer. but trading the MPL is not good idea until we see engulf of FL or opposite Origin of move is hit. The entry is at M5 demand area which is ORFL after engulf of previous SZFL. price also very well coincides with iQM which gives more odds to trade. also we can see price created BSZ just above the FL during move up to trap retailers. target is the first clean SR and the final one will be the MPL.

author: Kavya
text:
Thanks IF! and thanks einrikr and Rinehart! I wasn't expecting that surprise but it will really boost my confidence. but then again getting "Associate badge" brings me responsibility to help newcomers and all my other brothers as and when required.

So far it's long journey to me. Initially I started trading just because of curiosity that why people doing share marketing and what they do or achieve by standing in front of stock exchange building and talking on phone.I was thinking that they must be doing some kind of awesome job=)). My journey at first sight took very right direction by going to know about technical analysis and candlesticks. Then I enrolled into OTA, not for money but just for curiosity and then OTA taught me that supply and demand is real world. but then I wasn't satisfied as some trades were working fine but many of then was getting hit by Stop losses and SL was also big. So I started searching here and there,sometime I ride through indicators but again they were not telling me what I wanted to know. sometime I used trendline but again 'Q' rise for me why it working for some scripts and why not for others. Eventually when I was searching Supply and Demand again and again reading each and every website about Supply and Demand I reached to the destination called "RTM"! I found some logic and answers to my 'Q', from start what I was believing that market isn't random converted into confidence. Initially, I started learning all concepts and I traded using FTR, but then again it started hitting my SL. so I started to trade what FTRs are reaction to, that way I was getting less SLs hit. and when I was synchronizing the base of the FTRs with different scales it started getting more reward, but again I was still unknown about the fact and then I suddenly loose the grip on trading and Price Action as well, what I was gained become zero. then Sali come, initially I neglected his treads lot. but suddenly his way of trading started making sense to me. The way he picked up the market was really awesome. Then what I was trading in history the FTRs are reaction to (FL) come into light for me. I know there is still way ahead to reach to my goal of curiosity, but till that time I will continue my fight.

Instead of thanking one or other member, I will thanks to RTM,Thanks RTM!

text:
HDFC -- Housing Defense Finance Corporation. It's a twin of what I posted last HDFCBank which failed to hold prices down at my SZ and gave only 5R move. Generally, those trades which not hit my target, I take them as loss. I don't like trade giving me BE. but nowadays I'm just setting unrealistic targets, I might need to workout on that part. Okay! let's talk about this trade. I'm just trying to mix up IF's concept of FLs created due to break of SRs with scales and my thoughts. I might go wrong or end up with nothing but let's give it a try! (again because I tried it earlier but with amateur understanding).

Weekly -- So the first chart is of Weekly TF having Swing high candle and I plot horizontal line there to find out what happened in LTF. yep, I should have taken monthly first but as it's having no great short or long opportunity in short span of time. so I'm just going for what Mr.market offering.

Daily -- On daily tf, no significant DZ so it's just weekly SR. but after break of it price nicely created trick to take S/D traders out as well as breakout traders to exit their long positions. Only doubt about this trade is price is having fresh ignored FL level. So according to theory of magnetic attraction and repultion

price might FO to clean

ignored orders. On the opposite side price is reacting to CAP (also origin of the move) and not reached to FL yet! So again by Master Sali's words, price will have clean path to downside. (might not be perfect).here's chart...

text:
AjantaPharma -- Since last global recession, Pharma Sector was doing good. It made lot of money for lot of people. but will ITs like to be herd in profit? Certainly, if ITs money start coming from other sources. So after market boosted and started bullish territory, ITs just played with hope of retailers that Pharma sector should go up and from last bulls come into market pharma has given negative returns. It's good example of sector rotation. Now they are just indulge into Metal and Finance sector (and also consumer good on second hand).

Let's take a look at charts.

Monthly --Let's see how symmetry plays out here. though price couldn't manage to engulf the Origin of upmove. and price also entered into limit of the flag as well as MPL. though it's 2TB. but nothing fearful as we have PA to play in LTF

Weekly --Weekly MPL is though still far away.

Daily --We got couple of QMs on Daily. one which it's qualified for QM. and which did (not marked, RTM is well trained to spot it out!) Though we have and engulf in much lower tf,HTF not suggest to plot any FL because it will be not valid until price hits next FL.(Remember -- we can only plot FLs if price hits target! -- most probably FLs, but tg often can be SR kinks.)

Hourly -- After the break of high price comes back to consume the orders, so next orders will be fresh FL DP to engulf high or MPLs. (though FL DP is perfectly lined up with old LS and essentially be kink!)

M5 -- Well let me show another QM, the valid one which wasn't plotted on HTF! Why I say it more valid? of course, it qualify for QM setup. but the old area of interest (FL holding price many times upside) was engulfed and price reached to Origin of move but couldn't managed to engulf it and moved north. so essentially is a trap!
